user.title: Blueprint Manager
user.description: Install Blueprint Manager to auto-deploy all blueprints and access the management panel from the sidebar.

list_blueprints.name: List Blueprints
list_blueprints.description: List all available blueprints grouped by category with instance counts.

get_blueprint_detail.name: Get Blueprint Detail
get_blueprint_detail.description: Get full parameter definitions for a single blueprint, including all input fields with selectors and defaults.

list_instances.name: List Instances
list_instances.description: List all automation and script instances.

type.name: Type
type.description: Filter by type: 'automation', 'script', or omit for both.

get_instance_detail.name: Get Instance Detail
get_instance_detail.description: Get current parameter values of an existing automation or script instance.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the automation or script, e.g. 'automation.adalight_living_room'.

create_instance.name: Create Instance
create_instance.description: Create a new automation or script from a blueprint.

name.name: Name
name.description: Friendly name for the new instance.

input.name: Input
input.description: Blueprint input values as key-value pairs.

update_instance.name: Update Instance
update_instance.description: Modify parameter values of an existing automation or script.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the automation or script to update.

input.name: Input
input.description: Key-value pairs to update (partial update supported).

delete_instance.name: Delete Instance
delete_instance.description: Delete an automation or script instance.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the automation or script to delete.

toggle_instance.name: Toggle Instance
toggle_instance.description: Enable, disable, or toggle an automation or script.

entity_id.name: Entity ID
entity_id.description: Entity ID of the automation or script.

recommend_blueprint.name: Recommend Blueprint
recommend_blueprint.description: Recommend matching blueprints based on a natural language description of user needs.

description.name: Description
description.description: Natural language description of what the user wants, e.g. 'auto-dim living room lights based on time of day'.

get_system_status.name: Get System Status
get_system_status.description: Get overall system status including deployed blueprint and instance counts.
